title: RBI Financial Awareness Messages (FAME 2024) & Fraud Prevention Advisory

sections.section_title: Protection of Financial Credentials and Passwords
sections.content: Reserve Bank of India reiterates that banks, financial institutions, and regulators never ask for sensitive credentials such as Account passwords, PIN, OTP, UPI PIN, Card CVV, or biometric data over telephone calls, SMS, email, or messaging apps. Any request for such credentials is an indicator of digital financial fraud.
key_takeaways: Never share OTP, UPI PIN, CVV, or net banking passwords with anyone
Regulators and banks never request confidential security credentials
UPI PIN is required ONLY to send/deduct money, NEVER to receive funds

sections.section_title: Remote Access and Screen Sharing Application Traps
sections.content: Fraudsters induce users to download screen sharing applications (e.g., AnyDesk, TeamViewer, QuickSupport) under the guise of technical support, KYC update, refund processing, or customer care verification. Once granted access, perpetrators capture financial credentials and execute unauthorized fund transfers.
key_takeaways: Do not download remote desktop or screen sharing tools at the behest of callers
Granting remote screen viewing access exposes banking screens and SMS OTPs

sections.section_title: Suspicious Mobile Apps and Unauthorized Financial Entities
sections.content: Public is cautioned against downloading mobile applications from unverified third-party websites, social media links, or APK downloads. Unauthorized entities lure individuals with promise of instant loans, exorbitant returns, or virtual trading without regulatory approvals. Genuine banking and lending apps are hosted by RBI-regulated entities listed on the RBI whitelist.
key_takeaways: Only install apps from verified official app stores and authorized publishers
Verify lending entities and regulated entities on RBI Sachet portal (sachet.rbi.org.in)
Beware of apps requesting excessive permissions (contacts, gallery, SMS access)

sections.section_title: UPI and QR Code Collect Request Frauds
sections.content: Fraudsters send payment requests or QR codes claiming they are transferring lottery winnings, cashback, refund, or investment returns to the victim. Scanning a QR code or entering a UPI PIN always results in money being debited from the user's account, never credited.
key_takeaways: Entering UPI PIN or scanning QR codes always debits money
Receiving money never requires entering a PIN or password

sections.section_title: Reporting to Sachet and Cybercrime Helplines
sections.content: In case of illegal deposit taking or suspicious entities accepting deposits without authorization, report the matter to the RBI Sachet portal (https://sachet.rbi.org.in). In case of financial cyber fraud, immediately contact helpline 1930 and inform your bank to block compromised payment cards and accounts.
key_takeaways: Report unauthorized deposit schemes on sachet.rbi.org.in
Call 1930 immediately to freeze financial transactions
Notify bank immediately to limit customer liability under RBI zero liability guidelines
